text.text: Production is experiencing multiple P1 failures: `payment-service` is returning `DB_CONN_TIMEOUT`, `PAYMENT_INIT_FAILED`, `OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space`, and `OOMKilled`/`CrashLoopBackOff` events, while `api-gateway` is returning 504s on `POST /api/v1/payments` and 401s on `GET /api/v1/profile` due to `auth-service` token validation timeouts from Redis. Affected services are `payment-service`, `api-gateway`, `postgres-primary`, `auth-service`, `redis-cache`, and the rollout for `payment-service` `v2.8.4` is degraded with only 1 of 6 replicas available. Overall severity is P1 with immediate user impact on payment submission, payment initialization, and authenticated access. The single most critical next step is to rollback or stabilize `payment-service` `v2.8.4` and stop the crash loop/OOM condition while relieving pressure on `postgres-primary`.
